# Billy Andrews

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty years old (at white sands concert)  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Appearance

Billy is a big, fat youth with a round, expressionless face.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)_

## Personality

Billy is a stolid youth who suffers from a painful lack of conversational gifts. He is extremely shy and has too much good sense to break his heart over rejection.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022)_

## Traits

- stolid  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>
- shy  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>
- lacks conversational gifts  <sub>[v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- marry Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012)</sub>

## History

Billy drove Anne Shirley and Jane Andrews in a double-seated buggy to the White Sands concert, insisting that Anne sit beside him on the front seat. After his father gave him the upper farm in his own name, he desired to get married. Too shy to ask Anne Shirley himself, he repeatedly urged his sister Jane until she proposed to Anne on his behalf. Following his rejection, he married Nettie Blewett, whom he and his mother also favored, and the couple made their public appearance together at the Avonlea church.

_Sources: [v1 c33 P6](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0006), [v1 c33 P28](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0028), [v3 c8 P12](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0012), [v3 c8 P22](../source/v03-c08.md#nw-v03-c08-p0022), [v3 c11 P0](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0000)_
